decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extensions, alterations and refurbishment would improve the existing B1 light industrial premises to meet current operational requirements for such a use. Due to its compatible scale, appearance and layout, the proposal would not harm the adjoining businesses, the appearance of the street scene, or result in conditions harmful to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area. The proposal would therefore comply with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), E.2.4 (Improvement of Employment Premises), E.3.1 (Disabled Access) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities For Developments) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the premises are occupied.

Condition : 4 - The development shall be constructed in the materials shown on the drawings hereby approved, or as otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval given.
description: Demolition of rear of existing building, erection of 2nd floor extension at front and alterations and recladding of elevations, incorporating new glazed canopy.
